spanish: Todo el acercante, el acercante a mishkán de Jehová, morirá. ¿Acaso acabamos de expirar?

findings.issue: מִשְׁכַּן is a common noun (H4908, singular construct). mishkán leaves that lemma untranslated; a common noun stays Spanish.

acabamos de expirar is the Latin American idiom ‘we have just expired’. תַּמְנוּ is qal perfect 1cp (come to an end) and לִגְוֺעַ is ל plus qal infinitive construct (to expire); the ל-infinitive is not the recent-past marker de.
¿Acaso? adds a note of ‘perhaps’ beyond the interrogative particle הַאִם; the question marks already carry the interrogative.

notes: Repetition of הַקָּרֵב, אֶל, יְהוָה, and 3ms יָמוּת match el acercante twice, a, Jehová, and morirá.
